meta.rationale: Your apps are books on a wooden shelf; pull one out by its spine and it opens.
meta.theme-about: library bookshelf: a full-screen canvas of a warm wooden bookcase with two shelves, each app a cloth-bound book spine of a different colour, height and width with its title in gold letters running down the spine, a little plant and bookends between them; the book under the pointer tilts forward, clicking it opens the app; a reading lamp glow, a card-catalogue drawer for everything else. Cosy, literary, physical. (#case, #catalogue)

desktop.canvas: local COL = {"#7a2e22", "#1f4e5f", "#2f5d3a", "#6b4c9a", "#8a6420", "#24324f", "#9a3b5a", "#3f6f6a", "#5a3a22"} local books, hot = {}, nil function draw(w, h, t) g.gradient(0, 0, w, h, "#3a2414", "#140c06") g.glow(w * 0.82, h * 0.12, w * 0.4, "rgba(255,200,120,0.18)") local x0, x1 = w * 0.12, w * 0.88 g.rect(x0 - 26, h * 0.16, x1 - x0 + 52, h * 0.76, "#2a170b") local shelves = {h * 0.5, h * 0.86} for _, sy in ipairs(shelves) do g.gradient(x0 - 26, sy, x1 - x0 + 52, 22, "#8a5a32", "#5a3a20") g.rect(x0 - 26, sy + 22, x1 - x0 + 52, 6, "rgba(0,0,0,0.45)") end local apps = g.apps() local px, py, over = g.pointer() books, hot = {}, nil local x, shelf = x0 + 30, 1 for i, a in ipairs(apps) do local bw = 44 + (i * 17 % 4) * 9 local bh = h * 0.27 + (i * 29 % 5) * 12 if x + bw > x1 - 20 or i == 7 then shelf, x = shelf + 1, x0 + 30 end if shelf > 2 then break end local base = shelves[shelf] books[#books + 1] = {x = x, y = base - bh, w = bw, h = bh, c = COL[(i - 1) % #COL + 1], name = a.name, id = a.id} x = x + bw + 6 if i == 3 then x = x + 60 end end for _, b in ipairs(books) do if over and px >= b.x and px <= b.x + b.w and py >= b.y and py <= b.y + b.h then hot = b.id end end for _, b in ipairs(books) do local lift = b.id == hot and 14 or 0 g.rect(b.x, b.y - lift, b.w, b.h, b.c, 3) g.gradient(b.x, b.y - lift, b.w * 0.35, b.h, "rgba(255,255,255,0.12)", "rgba(255,255,255,0.02)", 3) g.rect(b.x, b.y - lift + 18, b.w, 3, "#c99a3a") g.rect(b.x, b.y - lift + b.h - 24, b.w, 3, "#c99a3a") local name = b.name:upper() local n = math.min(#name, 12) for k = 1, n do g.text(b.x + b.w / 2 - 6, b.y - lift + 30 + (k - 1) * 19, name:sub(k, k), "#e8c877", 15, "PlayfairDisplay") end end local pxp, pyp = books[3] and (books[3].x + books[3].w + 14) or x0, shelves[1] g.rect(pxp, pyp - 46, 34, 46, "#8a4a2a", 3) for k = 0, 6 do local a = -1.2 + k * 0.4 g.line(pxp + 17, pyp - 46, pxp + 17 + math.sin(a) * 38, pyp - 46 - math.cos(a) * 44, "#4f8a3a", 5) end end function click(x, y) for _, b in ipairs(books) do if x >= b.x and x <= b.x + b.w and y >= b.y - 14 and y <= b.y + b.h then return "open:" .. b.id end end end
